shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls; cat package.json; find app src -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null
for f in app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; find lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head; for f in $(find lib -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rli "prefetch" . | head -40; grep -rn "unstable_prefetch\|instant\b\|prefetch=\"" . | head -40

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; ls 03-api-reference/04-functions | grep -i prefetch; cat 03-api-reference/04-functions/prefetch.md; grep -n "" 02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | sed -n 1,400p | grep -n -i "per-link\|prefetch()\|stage\|unstable\|## "

grep -n "prefetch\|navigation" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.js; grep -rn "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -3; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30
